structural_audit.source_correctness_argument: Payload multiplication is multiplication of homogeneous3x3 affine matrices. The combine operation returns the right map after the left map. The local scan preserves temporal order. The upsweep holds each interval total at its right endpoint; the downsweep sends the incoming prefix to the left child and left-total-after-prefix to the right child. Identity padding is neutral. Final local maps act on each chunk's incoming state. Induction on the tree gives all sequential states.
structural_audit.integer_bound_argument: For t steps, matrix entries are at most2^(t-1) in magnitude and affine bias components at most32768*(2^t-1). Actual state magnitude is at most32768*(2^(t+1)-1). With t<=32 all are below2^48. In the four-lane upsweep, even discarded lane calculations compose at most32 steps; the downsweep composes at most24. Thus masked intermediate calculations also fit int64. All pointer offsets fit int32.
structural_audit.storage_argument: Every kernel only reads the public inputs. The first stage writes valid local prefixes and one summary per chunk. Same-stream launches order scratch producers before consumers. The carry stage masks unused summary lanes to identity; the final stage masks the tail. The host allocates distinct output storage. Pointer-relative addressing handles legal offsets and shared input storage.
structural_audit.scope: Source algebra and integer/address bounds establish the control for the full public value domain. Enumerated operators and compiled GPU checks test those arguments; finite samples alone are not a proof over every input or GPU environment.
